name: PostHog
description: Product analytics: insights, events, funnels and feature flags in PostHog.
long_description:
PostHog's own hosted server. It queries insights and events, reads funnels and dashboards, and lists and changes feature flags.

You sign in through PostHog in your browser. Reading analytics is harmless; turning a feature flag on is a change to production, and is confirmed every time.

auth.instructions: Sign in to PostHog in your browser and choose the project this chat may read.

risk.notes: Reads your product analytics. A feature flag is production behaviour, so changing one is confirmed every time.
